text.en:
All fish cages, fish pens, fish traps, and other
aqua-culture structures in Taal Lake and the Pansipit River,
without any exceptions whatsoever;
shall be dismantled and
removed therefrom not later than 30 days from the promulgation of
this Executive Order.

A Task Force on the Dismantling of Fish Cages,
Pens, Fish Traps, and other Aqua-culture Structures in Taal
and the Pansipit River and Establishment of Permanent Fish
Zones in Taal Lake is hereby created as follows:
IN REPLYING, PLEASE CITE:
PFUR lattor

3. The Task Force shall have the following mandate,
mission, tasks, and functions:
a. Zone Taal Lake and identify areas within the Lake wherein
permanent fish cages may be allowed.
b. conduct a public information program about the official
fish cage zones and the reasons why there is a need
c. Cause the dismantling of fish cages,
fish pens, fish
traps, and other aqua-culture structures in Taal Lake and
River not later than
30
promulgation of this Proclamation.
d. Cause and assist in the establishment of locally-based
Cooperatives that will henceforth own, manage,
and benefit from the fish cage industry in Taal Lake.
3. Devise and cause the establishment of a regular mechanism
manned by existing national and local governmental
agencies/units for sustaining the efforts of regulating
the fish cage industry in Taal Lake.

- 3 -
4. Funds needed for the fulfillment of the above
tasks, and functions shall come from the
existing budgets of the above mentioned government agencies
5. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately
and remain in force until the above stated tasks shall have been
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of January
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety six.
By the President:
Executive Secretary
